messages.text: Why is the globe shown on the French edition page in English?

I'm not sure why the product photo shows English text on that page — product images aren't something I have details on, and it's possible the photo just hasn't been swapped for the French map yet even though the listing itself is the French-language edition. I'd rather not guess: could you email (email hidden) with a link to the page, or want me to flag it to the owner directly? If you'd like, I can also confirm what I do know about the Explorer 12" Blue Ocean Desk Globe (French Edition) itself.
